limitations: These are municipal budgets and forecasts, not independent SKR model outputs.
Original budget documents for 2020–2024 were not recovered. The 2020 budget is derived from a retrospectively reported variance.
Adoption date is not a verified publication date or information cutoff. Unknown dates remain null.
Do not submit these records to the matched-date scorer until forecast provenance and actual publication dates are established.
Current M1 historical predictions use full prior-year accounts, which may postdate a municipal budget adopted the preceding autumn.
The project's outcome series rounds 2021 to 62 and 2022 to 125. Source outcomes here preserve 61.7 and 125.1. No training data changed.
2023 annual-report follow-up table gives 24 while its income statement gives 23. Use income-statement 23 as outcome; keep conflict visible.
